name: vuesp.shinwa-bms
summary: Saihang/Anenji LiFePO4 BMS monitor over RS232 with cell, current and protection data.
description:
## Vuesp Saihang BMS

ESP32-C3 monitor for Saihang/Anenji 12.8 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 batteries. The BMS is polled over RS232 at 9600 baud using the ASCII-HEX protocol (`~` frame start, `\r` frame end).

The firmware reads model, version and serial number, the analog pack (voltage, current, capacity and four cell voltages) and the warning/status pack (charge/discharge MOSFETs, cell and pack protections, temperatures). The standard Vuesp dashboard, Wi-Fi, ScriptRunner, LittleFS and OTA features are included.
